items.title: Mermaid Magic
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
Adventure into the ocean, and find a new world of magic with these sounding siren skins!
- 10 unique skins
- by Billii

items.title: Berry Cute
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Explore your sweet side with these adorable skins! Each with a berry theme, you can look super cute with your favorite fruit! 

+ 12 unique skins for you to choose from!

items.title: Panda Sanctuary Survival
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Take a look at Panda Sanctuary Survival today! It is made up of tons of old ruins. The pandas have taken them over and turned them into their home! Explore the island for loot, a minigame, and more!

- Boat racing
- Extensive map
- Great for panda lovers
- Licensed by 5 Frame Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Monster Mobs
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Spooky, scary, and so much more! These skins are perfect for your mob adventures!

items.title: Medieval Knights
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: These Knights now have the fanciest crowns in all the land! Rule with an iron sword, or better yet, a diamond sword!

items.title: Neon Drip HD
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Transform into a neon drip skin with HD vivid and vibrant shades. From the infinite world, all the way to the end. Protect and defend your realm to become the most glowing warrior Minecraft has ever seen!

items.title: Error Teens
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Error found in teens! Check out these awesome trendy glitch skins!

- 8 skins
- Glitch Skins
- By KA Studios

items.title: Samurai Family HD
items.creator: Impress
items.description:
Enjoy a colorful and beautiful kimono or become a cool looking Samurai!

- A total of 33 HD skins with 10 variants
- Colorful and beautifully detailed designs!
- Each skin has 3 different eyes!

Creator:Futaribotch

items.title: Emo Teens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Be an emo teen! Roleplay in dark colored fashion!

+ 10 skins included!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Rich Teen Stars
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description: Be a rich teen star! Roleplay as a millionaire!

items.title: Sirenhead Horrors
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Beware of monstrous and famous siren heads. This skin pack brings you brand-new versions of well-known horrors. Choose your favorite and spook your friends!

+ Monsters
+ Scary
+ Horrors
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Dark Fashion Teens
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
This skin pack is created for true dark tone lovers. The overall dark and teen fashion vibe will stand out your character among the other players. Join the game with your favourite skin pick and shine darkly.

+ Modern Fashion
+ Anime Style
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Anime Bots
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: The universe is at war, and factions are being formed. Show your allegiance with these anime-themed bot skins!

items.title: Modded Tools and Secret Armory
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Welcome Hacker. A brand new armory has been built for you. Explore it and discover all the new hacker tools that will give you a definite edge in your survival.

- 100 Hacker Tools
- Secret Armory
- Chest room
- Growing room

items.title: TNT Teens
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Boom! Try not to hurt yourself up while exploding your mines! Become what causes the most joy: a huge explosion. Dress up as a TNT Teen and fit right in as the walls come crumbling down around you!

- 10 skins (1 free)
- By 57Digital

items.title: Puzzle Cubes
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Left, down, up, right... Where was I again? Confuse your friends with everyone's favorite multicolored squares with the Puzzle Cubes skin pack! Can they figure out how to put all the colors together?

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Block Buddies 4
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to cosplay as a nether portal? Well, now's your chance! Dress up as some Block Buddies and become all those beautiful blocks you've always wanted to be!

- 10 chunky skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Horror Village
items.creator: Diveblocks
items.description:
It's been sixty-two years since the nightmare ended, when Hans saved his town and parents. Dive into Frick's Lock evil days and Hans worst fears. Are you ready to uncover The Sinister?

- Spooky jumpscares and sound effects!
- Unique music and voice lines
- Slingshot weapon experience!
- Custom models and new mobs

items.title: Infinite Parkour
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
An endless parkour challenge! Change the difficulty and race your friends to the next challenge in Infinite Parkour! 

+ 3 different difficulties 
+ Over 50 modules and droppers 
+ Infinite randomly generated parkour
+ High score system
+ Multiplayer friendly

items.title: Lucky Block Skins
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
If you love all things lucky block then this skin pack is for you! Use one of these skins and maybe it will raise your luck when breaking blocks!

- 13 lucky block skins

items.title: Cats
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
A day in the life of cats is a rambunctious one to say the least. Join these felines for the best day ever of pure fun and games! Roleplay as a precious kitty and knock over everything that has yet to be knocked over. Which fluffy pampered cat skin will you choose?

- 12 skins

items.title: Star Teens
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These teens shine bright like the stars! They light up the night sky wherever they go and look amazing while doing so! Space is one big fashion runway for these star teens!

- 13 skins

items.title: Teen Pets
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description: These cute skins will keep your skills fresh and your keyboard hot! Be the most popular skin out in the field as you wear these adorable suits to your next adventure. Every teen will be turning their head to watch you go by.

items.title: MLB Home Run Derby
items.creator: The Misfit Society
items.description:
Batter up! Join your favorite Major League Baseball team and swing for the fences in a fast-paced home run competition. Pick from all 30 MLB teams and test your reflexes and accuracy in your favorite MLB ballpark or Minecraft biome!

UPDATED for the 2025 season

A minigame by The Misfit Society.
